title: Allen Visual Coding: Fatigue Threshold Dynamics
description: Falsification-side coverage for fatigue threshold dynamics using Allen Brain Atlas data structure. Tests whether P3b amplitude decays under fatigue in the APGI-predicted pattern, and whether ignition threshold elevation under fatigue follows the adaptive ODE trajectory.
prediction_cluster_label: Allen Visual Coding: Fatigue Threshold Dynamics

sub_predictions.claim: P3b amplitude shows significant monotonic decline under extended cognitive load (fatigue)
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: P3b amplitude declines monotonically over the task in a pattern consistent with θₜ elevation dynamics.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: No significant P3b decline (slope p > 0.05) or non-monotonic pattern — fatigue threshold prediction is falsified.

sub_predictions.claim: Ignition threshold θₜ elevation under fatigue follows adaptive ODE trajectory within ±30%
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: Measured threshold elevation during fatigue is within 30% of adaptive ODE simulation.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: Observed threshold elevation deviates > 30% from ODE prediction — adaptive model does not describe fatigue dynamics.

validation_notes: FP-15 stub — not yet implemented. VP-17 provides the validation-side coverage. Fatigue dynamics are at XP-P4-Prog4 level (outside canonical 14-prediction tally). Theory/APGI_Fractal_Threshold_Dynamics.py is the canonical threshold dynamics module.

inclusion_criteria: Allen Visual Coding dataset or equivalent simulated neural time-series is available
Fatigue proxy (run length, RT slowing, P3b proxy) is available in dataset
exclusion_criteria: Dataset lacks temporal structure to estimate fatigue trajectory
Insufficient trial count for slope estimation (< 40 trials)

apparatus.execution_environment: APGI desktop application and local project runtime
apparatus.data_source: Allen Brain Atlas visual coding dataset (simulated structure)
apparatus.notes: Software-only execution using simulated or Allen Institute data.

target.type: Simulated or archival visual neural response epoch

trial_structure.response: Programmatic score from fatigue trajectory analysis
trial_structure.session_structure: Offline analysis pipeline on extended recording block

blocks.notes: Single analysis pass over full recording session; fatigue assessed as a within-session temporal trend.

dependent_variables: P3b proxy amplitude slope over session (fatigue trajectory)
Estimated θₜ elevation vs. adaptive ODE prediction
primary_hypothesis: P3b amplitude will decline monotonically under fatigue, and the observed ignition threshold elevation will be within 30% of the adaptive ODE prediction, consistent with APGI fatigue dynamics.
primary_analysis: Linear regression of P3b proxy vs. trial index for slope estimation; comparison of empirical θₜ trajectory against ODE simulation output.

power_analysis.based_on: Software-only fatigue simulation; power analysis is not applicable but required by schema

ethics.exempt_reason: Software-only execution using simulated or publicly available Allen Institute data.

submission_blocking_issues: FP_15 is a stub — run_validation() returns not_implemented.
Allen Visual Coding data ingestion pipeline not yet connected.
P3b proxy extraction from Allen data structure not implemented.
caveats: FP-15 predictions are supplementary (XP-P4-Prog4 level) and NOT counted in the canonical 14-prediction tally.
VP_17 is the validation-side counterpart (also extended/supplementary).
Theory/APGI_Fractal_Threshold_Dynamics.py is the canonical threshold dynamics reference.
